ns2:section.sectionText: This is an 'A' Lecture section. Students must also register for an 'A' Discussion section. Please note some Quiz sections will be RESTRICTED for economics major students, and other sections are open to all other majors. Capacities in sections may fluctuate, but we will not provide overrides for sections at capacity (be cautious when changing your schedule if the section is full as you may lose your seat). Read more about Economics Course Restrictions and Overrides: http://www.economics.illinois.edu/undergrad/resources/current/
